S31.01.needs: none; a chat with a finished assistant answer
S31.01.note: Only answer text (and documents or artifacts) becomes a PDF; no control was found that converts an uploaded Word or text file attachment itself to PDF. Artifacts also offer PDF under Download artifact (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/ArtifactFullScreen.tsx).
steps: Open a chat that has an assistant answer with text.
Long-press the answer (or use the More message actions control under it).
Tap Export Message….
Tap Export as PDF and wait for the share sheet.
Compare: a PDF of the answer text opens or shares, with the formatting kept. Compare with Expected.
S31.01.where: Chat > long-press an answer > Export Message… > Export as PDF

S31.02.note: Searched apps/mobile for spreadsheet, xlsx and PDF export. Spreadsheet attachments are accepted in Cloud mode (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/utils/attachmentValidation.ts), but the only PDF export options found are for answers, conversations and text or markdown artifacts (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/utils/artifactExport.ts, apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/ConversationExportSheet.tsx). No spreadsheet-to-PDF control was found.

S31.04.needs: a PDF file with readable text; Cloud mode (the File row is shown only in Cloud mode)
S31.04.note: The File row is shown only when the app is in Cloud mode (AddToChatSheet.tsx). The summary itself is produced by the model on the server (apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/chat-attachment-hydration.ts), so the exact wording is not fixed by code.
steps: Open a chat (Cloud mode) or start a new one.
Tap Add to chat (the plus button by the message box).
Tap File and choose a PDF file.
Wait until the file chip above the message box is ready, type "Summarize this PDF", and send.
Compare: the answer gives a summary of the PDF content. Compare with Expected.
S31.04.where: Chat > Add to chat > File, pick a PDF, then send a request to summarize it

S31.05.needs: a PDF file with readable text; Cloud mode
S31.05.note: The File row is shown only in Cloud mode. Answers are produced by the server-side model path in apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/chat-attachment-hydration.ts.
steps: Open a chat in Cloud mode.
Tap Add to chat, then tap File and choose a PDF file.
Type a specific question about a fact in the PDF and send.
Compare: the answer gives the fact as it appears in the PDF. Compare with Expected.
S31.05.where: Chat > Add to chat > File, pick a PDF, then ask a question about it

S31.06.needs: a multi-page PDF file; Cloud mode
S31.06.note: Page handling is server-side: each page is sent as a [Page n] marker and image (apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/chat-attachment-hydration.ts:702). The page markers are not shown to the user. The page viewer shows Page N of M (apps/mobile/src/features/chat/components/artifact-viewers/PdfFileView.tsx:197).
steps: Attach a multi-page PDF with Add to chat > File in Cloud mode.
Type "What is on page 3?" (use a page number that exists in the file) and send.
Compare: the answer describes page 3 and not another page. Compare with Expected.
S31.06.where: In the chat answer, after attaching a PDF with Add to chat > File and asking about one page

S31.07.needs: a PDF with a text layer; a Cloud or local-mode chat
S31.07.note: No button that shows or copies the extracted plain text was found. Local mode extracts PDF text on the phone (apps/mobile/services/docParser.ts, extractTextFromPdfBuffer). The old code location apps/mobile/app/(app)/chat/[id].tsx:1052 now holds research-decision code, so it was not used.
steps: Attach a PDF with Add to chat > File.
Type "Write out all of the text in this PDF exactly as it appears" and send.
Compare: the answer contains the plain text of the PDF, without layout or tables. Compare with Expected.
S31.07.where: Chat > Add to chat > File (attach a PDF), then ask for its text

S31.08.needs: a scanned (image-only) PDF; a project you can edit
S31.08.note: The OCR transcription runs on the server in apps/web/lib/server/project-knowledge-extraction.ts. The Projects tab label and the project screen wording were not confirmed in apps/mobile, and the file picker used by Add sources was not traced. In a plain chat, scanned pages are sent to the model as images instead of OCR text.
steps: Open the Projects tab and open a project.
Tap Add sources and choose an image-only (scanned) PDF.
Wait until the source row leaves the Indexing state.
Ask a question whose answer is only in the scanned pages, in a chat inside that project.
Compare: the answer uses text from the scan, and a failed source shows Couldn’t read. Compare with Expected.
S31.08.where: Projects > open a project > Add sources (choose a scanned PDF), then ask about text that appears only in the scan

S31.09.note: Searched apps/mobile and apps/web for table and tabular handling in PDF code. The only PDF path returns plain text and page text (apps/mobile/services/docParser.ts, apps/web/lib/server/pdf-attachment-content.ts); table rows and columns exist only for CSV files (docParser.ts parseCsvToText, rows and columns metadata). The cited apps/mobile/stores/chat/chatExecutionStore.ts:1702 is attachment replay, not table extraction.
